The '''32nd Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2021 Producers Guild Awards''' or '''2021 PGA Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2020, were held virtually on March 24, 2021.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Davis |first1=Clayton |last2=Shafer |first2=Ellise |title='Nomadland' Wins Top Film Prize at Producers Guild Awards, Likely Locking It Up at the Oscars |url=https://variety.com/2021/awards/news/producers-guild-awards-winners-2021-1234937556/ |access-date=March 25, 2021 |work=Variety |date=March 24, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Hipes |first1=Patrick |title=PGA Awards: 'Nomadland' Wins Best Picture, 'Schitt's Creek', 'The Crown' Top TV – Complete Winners List |url=https://deadline.com/2021/03/producers-guild-awards-2021-winners-list-1234718035/ |website=Deadline |access-date=March 24, 2021 |date=March 20, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Winners Announced for 32nd Annual Producers Guild Awards |url=https://producersguild.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/PGA-Award-Winners-2021.pdf |publisher=Producers Guild of America |access-date=April 12, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210407090945/https://producersguild.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/PGA-Award-Winners-2021.pdf |archive-date=April 7, 2021 |date=March 24, 2021}}</ref> The nominations in the documentary category were announced on February 2, 2021,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Tangcay |first1=Jazz |title='Truffle Hunters,' 'Time' and 'Dick Johnson Is Dead' Among Producers Guild Doc Nominations |url=https://variety.com/2021/awards/awards/time-truffle-hunters-producer-guild-documentary-nominations-1234898431/ |access-date=February 3, 2021 |work=Variety |date=February 2, 2021}}</ref> the nominees in the sports, children's and short-form categories were announced on February 26, 2021,<ref>{{cite news |last1=Schneider |first1=Michael |title=Producers Guild Awards Reveals 2021 Nominations for Sports, Children’s and Short Form TV Categories |url=https://variety.com/2021/tv/awards/producers-guild-awards-2021-nominations-sports-childrens-short-form-1234916453/ |access-date=February 27, 2021 |work=Variety |date=February 26, 2021}}</ref> and the remaining nominations for film and television were announced on March 8, 2021.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pedersen |first1=Erik |title=PGA Awards Nominations: 'Borat', 'Ma Rainey', 'Chicago 7', 'Nomadland', 'Mank' & 'Minari' Among Pics Vying For Marquee Prize |url=https://deadline.com/2021/03/pga-awards-nominations-2021-borat-ma-rainey-trial-of-the-chicago-7-nomadland-mank-minari-1234709098/ |website=Deadline |access-date=March 8, 2021 |date=March 8, 2021}}</ref> The finalists for the PGA Innovation Award were announced on March 17, 2021.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Welk |first1=Brian |title=12 VR and AR Projects Nominated for Producers Guild Innovators Award |url=https://www.thewrap.com/producers-guild-innovators-award-vr-ar-projects-nominated/ |website=The Wrap |access-date=March 17, 2021 |date=March 17, 2021}}</ref>
